sequence.cn: 你有没有过，突然破防的时候？
sequence.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu guò, tūrán pò fáng de shíhou?

sequence.cn: 破防，原来是游戏里的词，意思是攻破了防御。
sequence.py: Pò fáng, yuánlái shì yóuxì lǐ de cí, yìsi shì gōngpòle fángyù.
sequence.en: 破防 was originally a gaming word — it means breaking through someone's defenses.

sequence.cn: 现在，破防是指心理防线被击穿，情绪绷不住了。
sequence.py: Xiànzài, pò fáng shì zhǐ xīnlǐ fángxiàn bèi jīchuān, qíngxù bēng bù zhù le.
sequence.en: Now, 破防 means your emotional defenses are pierced, and your feelings can't hold back.

sequence.cn: 小刚是个一米八的大个子，从来不流泪。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Gāng shì ge yì mǐ bā de dà gèzi, cónglái bù liúlèi.
sequence.en: Xiao Gang is a 1.8-meter-tall big guy who never cries.

sequence.cn: 他常说："我这么坚强，什么都不能让我破防。"
sequence.py: Tā cháng shuō: "Wǒ zhème jiānqiáng, shénme dōu bùnéng ràng wǒ pò fáng."
sequence.en: He often says: "I'm so tough, nothing can make me break down."

sequence.cn: 直到有一天，他接到了妈妈的电话。
sequence.py: Zhídào yǒu yìtiān, tā jiēdàole māma de diànhuà.
sequence.en: Until one day, he got a phone call from his mom.

sequence.cn: 妈妈只说了一句："天冷了，记得加衣服。"
sequence.py: Māma zhǐ shuōle yí jù: "Tiān lěng le, jìde jiā yīfu."
sequence.en: His mom said just one thing: "It's getting cold — remember to wear more."

sequence.cn: 就这么简单的一句话，小刚突然就破防了。
sequence.py: Jiù zhème jiǎndān de yí jù huà, Xiǎo Gāng tūrán jiù pò fáng le.
sequence.en: Just this one simple sentence, and Xiao Gang suddenly broke down.

sequence.cn: 原来，最坚强的人，也会被最普通的爱轻轻击穿。
sequence.py: Yuánlái, zuì jiānqiáng de rén, yě huì bèi zuì pǔtōng de ài qīngqīng jīchuān.
sequence.en: It turns out, even the toughest person can be gently pierced by the most ordinary love.
